correctness.rationale: For unit-area equal-length-basis rhombic tori c=cos(angle) in [0,1/2], Haar translation invariance reduces the distance of two independent uniform points to the Voronoi-cell norm. With Gram coordinates u,v, the cell is [-1/2,1/2]^2 minus two triangles of side c, i.e. |u-v|<=1-c. Direct integration of (u²+v²-2cuv)^k/(1-c²)^k for k=1,2 and area/covolume normalization yields Var(d²)=(3c^4+2c^3-7c²+4c+2)/(180(1-c)(1+c)^3). Independent SymPy rational identities exactly matched the raw moment polynomials, variance and factored derivative -c(2c-1)(c²+2c-7)/(90(1-c)^2(1+c)^4), strictly negative for 0<c<1/2. Endpoint values 1/90 and 43/4860, quadratic deficits 7c²/180 and 92(1/2-c)²/3645 confirmed symbolically. The universal integral and sign analysis, not a finite checker, prove all c.
